prompt:
Create a polished labeled PIXEL-ART WEAPON SPRITE SHEET MOCKUP for the game DRAIN DAMAGE. Portrait large canvas 1536x2048. Dark navy flat background, crisp chunky SNES-style sprites, teal/copper/steel/orange plumbing tools, clean cream highly legible typography. Reference image is style and Pressure Gun identity reference only. Not a gameplay screenshot or animation atlas; an inventory concept overview. Title "DRAIN DAMAGE — WEAPON ROSTER". Subtitle "6 catalog weapons + 7 concepts | Mockup, not runtime sprites". Exactly THREE COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS of equally sized organized cards below header. Each card has one large isolated side-view pixel art tool above its exact name and smaller category/status labels. First13cards contain weapons, final2cards contain concise legends. Generous spacing, no cropped labels, readable text. No characters, hands, real weapon manufacturing instructions or branding.
Cards in strict row-major order:
1 "Pipe Wrench" / "MELEE" / "CATALOG · TONY": compact teal-handled steel pipe wrench.
2 "Drain Snake" / "MELEE · EXTENDED REACH" / "CATALOG · TONY": coiled flexible steel cable with small auger and hand grip.
3 "Pressure Gun" / "SHORT-RANGE" / "PLAYABLE · TONY": brass barrel teal pistol grip cream pressure gauge, little cyan water bolt, match reference.
4 "Demolition Hammer" / "MELEE" / "CATALOG · SEAN": oversized steel sledgehammer orange grip.
5 "Heavy Plunger Launcher" / "SHORT-RANGE · HALF-SCREEN" / "PLAYABLE · SEAN": bulky orange and silver launcher, red plunger cup on barrel tip.
6 "Pipe-Bomb Launcher" / "LONG-RANGE · LOBBED" / "CATALOG · SEAN": exaggerated fictional chunky industrial teal/orange launcher, capped cartoon canister nearby; no construction details.
7 "Kinetic Air Ram" / "SHORT-RANGE" / "IDEA": cylindrical metal hand pump with pistol grip black rubber nozzle and subtle white air puff.
8 "Toilet Auger" / "MELEE · EXTENDED REACH" / "IDEA": bent tubular handle with crank and long flexible whipping cable, visually different from coiled drain snake.
9 "Plunger Water Wave" / "LONG-RANGE · SCREEN-WIDE" / "IDEA · SPECIAL": upright wooden plunger planted in small floor patch unleashing curling cyan wave, no hero.
10 "Soldering Torch" / "SHORT-RANGE" / "IDEA": compact B-tank connected by hose to brass torch with short orange flame; stylized tool, no real branding.
11 "Three-Foot Pipe Wrench" / "MELEE" / "IDEA": huge long red-handled pipe wrench, clearly longer heavier than card1.
12 "Drain-Machine Cable" / "LONG-RANGE · SCREEN-WIDE" / "IDEA · SPECIAL": squat wheeled red industrial drain machine and forward shooting cable, no branding.
13 "Pressure Fan" / "SHORT-RANGE · SPREAD" / "IDEA · TONY PICKUP": modified brass/teal pressure gun with flared three-jet nozzle and three separated blue bolts.
14 Text-only legend: "STATUS" then "PLAYABLE: current starters" then "CATALOG: designed, not all playable" then "IDEA: proposed, not approved".
15 Text-only legend: "RANGE NOTES" then "Idea ranges are provisional." then "Augers use melee reach." then "Specials are not ordinary weapons." then "Overlapping concepts remain separate."
Keep exact names correctly spelled, all13weapons visible, no invented extra weapons. Each tool recognizable at small size with dark outlines, pixel highlights, consistent visual scale except intentional giant wrench. No photorealism.
